hints.title: Track Prior Occurrences of B
hints.text: Count how many b characters have appeared before the current position.

hints.title: Choice When Encountering A
hints.text: When seeing an a preceded by b, choose between deleting this a or deleting an earlier b.

hints.title: Running Deletion Counter
hints.text: Maintain minimum deletions so far: min_del = min(min_del + 1, b_count).

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Prefix/suffix balance point calculation takes two passes if not done iteratively.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: A single pass with two counters runs in O(n) time and O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate formulates DP transition min(del + 1, b_count) or equivalent stack approach.
